json.task: Integrate Brevo with a custom web application to send transactional emails.
benefits: Excellent performance and reliability for sending transactional emails.
Clear and well-guided domain authentication setup using DNS records.
Flawless integration via SMTP and transactional API with virtually zero delivery delay.
Real-time transactional logs are useful for monitoring dispatch status.
frictions: Initial account verification and domain validation require strict attention to DNS record configurations.
The verification process can involve a slight learning curve for users unfamiliar with server or DNS management.
